name: the event converter skips the site-icon pass
why: The reported bug: applyEventDetailsToTables() built its URL table without _sbIconRelLinks(), so the review link had its icon in the sidebar card and none in the table.
grep: the review link shows its sidebar icon

name: the Credits button does not name the YouTube button's selector
why: The reported bug: the Credits render replaces the page's features, so release-tracks' removeSelectors never reached it and the third-party button stayed at the foot of the page.
grep: stripped from the Credits render too

name: _relTablesButton() drops its extra features
why: The 5th parameter is the only way a page-specific feature reaches a replaceFeatures render; if it is not merged, the Credits removeSelectors silently disappears.
grep: stripped from the Credits render too

name: the site-link gate never opens
why: Name AND render decide; a gate that never opens leaves the URL/Target/Link panels without site entries, silently.

name: the site kind is the host
why: The country-independent count is the whole of item 3: a kind equal to the host never merges amazon.com and amazon.de.

name: the country second-level label is not stripped
why: co.uk/com.br must go with the country code, or amazon.co.uk is its own kind "co.*".

name: an entry gets no icon name
why: The icon is the link's own, by name; never recording it leaves every entry without its icon.

name: the icon rule does not cover the 📊 span
why: The span reuses the rule _sbIconRef() writes; with the old a-only selector the entry carries the name and draws nothing.

name: entity rows of a mixed Target column count
why: A Target cell typed as another entity must hold no site; without the type check its MusicBrainz-relative links are skipped anyway, so this guard is defence in depth.

name: the site maps are left out of the 📊 cache
why: A re-opened panel is served from the cache bundle; a Map missing there re-opens empty.

name: a site tick marks nothing
why: The tick narrows the rows; the host inside the link text is the mark that says where.

name: the site kind section shows without a 2-site kind
why: Without the 2+ rule the kind section repeats the site section entry for entry.

name: Relationships icons get no site kind
why: The Relationships column side of item 3: no family per icon, no "amazon.*" entry.

name: the Discogs finding never matches
why: The detector is the whole finding.

name: a query variant of one Discogs URL counts twice
why: Two raw strings of ONE page are not two links: without the origin+path key the release/4?ev=rr row is flagged too.

name: the Relationships writer never re-stamps
why: stampFindings() saw the cells empty; without the per-row re-stamp the finding never appears.

name: the Discogs tint setting is ignored
why: The tint must follow its own setting, while the menu row stays.

name: the late re-stamp re-runs no filter for the Discogs finding
why: While the finding is ticked, a row stamped later must be filtered in; only _LATE_FINDING_IDS decides. Not visible here: every cell is written before the tick, so nothing is stamped while it filters.
